context-carries-authority.json.note: Retrieved document asserts developer authority. This is the shape a successful prompt injection takes.

instruction-hash-drift.json.note: Instruction text no longer matches its recorded hash; policy wording drifted between build and replay.

undeclared-authority.json.note: Instruction cites a source absent from authority[]; the artifact cannot say who was entitled to issue it.

authority-rank-escalation.json.note: User-rank task instruction claims developer rank, which would let it win against the evidence contract.

unjustified-effort.json.note: High effort was allocated without referencing the policy or mode that funded it.

effort-exceeds-budget.json.note: Reasoning effort exceeds the declared budget envelope.

canonical-hash-drift.json.note: Declared canonical hash does not reproduce the document; the build is not replay-verifiable.

lost-instruction.build.json.note: Compiler dropped an instruction without recording it as suppressed.

silent-suppression.build.json.note: A conflicting instruction was suppressed without naming the winner.

unattributed-promotion.build.json.note: Context was promoted to instruction rank on user authority; only system or developer may admit a promotion.

missing-required-verification.build.json.note: Build declares verification.mode 'required' but records no verification.
